notes.title: 🔥 HUMANS ARE NOT THAT AGAINST LIZARDWOMEN 2 - DEMO IS OUT NOW 🔥
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39402905/43d8f05d421b808c9065c5f6342694d28220576a.png

An epic adventure where brave Rus warriors clash with seductive lizard invaders from the melting glaciers! Steamy scenes, exciting match-3 gameplay, full voice acting, and a surprisingly deep, twisted plot await!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39402905/9903281567113536771f9e30a61114be1fcdb073.png

Play part 1 now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715650

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39402905/95b5d61727d4a01cc3190162c2b7e517daf30b4f.png

Didn’t get enough of sexy lizards and red-haired maidens? Don’t worry — the story continues! Very soon we’ll be releasing a fiery Part 2 with even more gorgeous girls, hot reptilian temptresses, spicy scenes, and wild plot twists! Right now you can check out the demo version of Part Two ⬇️

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39402905/3afa7c9316b3a64152b7e2f49787795e74bfaf3f.png

🐉A fresh story arc with new threats - unlike before, but just as intriguing;

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39402905/7a1e2cfeac831d9fd2c43327c70fb0d36c37389e.png

🐉Dolboslav takes the spotlight, kicking off the chaos;

Fan favorites Veinte, Ratibor, Gachislav, and Gachislava return - fully voiced from the start;
English voiceover is also available (partially for now);

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39402905/abcb57011849bcc5a8f929318554e9ffe7d68c1a.png

🐉New characters - both kind and sinister (yes, even some capitalist demons 😈);

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39402905/4417a5dd1b8c0d8ce1563caea9dfaa4e7c1ef658.png

And of course - steamy scenes and gorgeous art - just how you like it 🔥🔥🔥

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39402905/0fa93094856b0153bfb39c630bccd0e4e038604a.png

 ⚡ If you like what you see, play the demo and add the game to your wishlist - that’s the best way to support us right now  ⚡
